_note: Holiday travel, touring, accommodation and other expenses the employer paid, bore or reimbursed, other than leave travel concession: "the amount of the expenditure"; for a facility the employer maintains and does not offer uniformly, its value "offered by other agencies to the public"; a household member on official tour, their expenses; a tour extended as a vacation, the extension's expenses; less recoveries (D-119). The amount is entered by kind; this row values it. For every employee. Every regime. TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.15(5) Table IV (Gazette 271092, p.1545). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3(7) (consolidated rule 3, pp.3–4).

provenance.whatToCheck: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3(7)(ii) is read in the Income Tax Department's consolidated rule 3, not in the Gazette: its words date from the substitution of rule 3 by S.O. 3245(E), 18-12-2009 (Notification No. 94/2009, the Income-tax (Thirteenth Amendment) Rules, 2009, in force from 1-4-2009) as corrected by S.O. 66(E), 12-1-2010 (Notification No. 2/2010), and neither Gazette copy is on egazette.gov.in (its 2009 Part II s.3(ii) scans stop before December 2009) — read them in a Gazette copy. The later amendments of rule 3 that the consolidation and the amendment list name are read in the Gazette (G.S.R. 415(E) of 2020, 452(E), 615(E) and 636(E) of 2023), and the Gazette amendment chain from 1-9-2025 to 31-3-2026 touches no part of rule 3 (docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-10-rule-3.md).
